verdict.rationale: BugSnag docs mention event-usage controls to limit which events count toward quota (docs-14) and error status/actions that imply ignore/resolve workflows (docs-3), which loosely map to 'mute/ignore rules', but there is no evidence of spike protection or per-key rate limiting mechanisms, and no documentation tying these to alert/paging suppression for on-call fatigue. missing for 10: explicit spike-protection feature, per-key rate limiting, and mute/ignore rule documentation tied to alert routing (PagerDuty/Slack).
